Button.GMHint: Click: toggle access for players. Shift+click: roll risky yourself.
Button.Rules: Not with advantage/disadvantage. No rerolls (e.g. Halfling Lucky).

Notify.NotAvailable: The risky d20 is not unlocked right now.
Notify.Unlocked: The GM has unlocked the risky d20.
Notify.Locked: The GM has locked the risky d20 again.
Notify.Advantage: The risky d20 can't be used with advantage or disadvantage. The roll was made normally, the risky d20 stays armed.
Notify.RerollsRemoved: Rerolls (e.g. Halfling Lucky) don't apply to the risky d20.

Count.Name: Number of ones and twenties
Count.Hint: How many faces of the risky d20 show a 1 and a 20. The neighbouring faces are removed: with 2 there is no 2 and no 19, with 3 also no 3 and no 18, and so on. The average stays 10.5.

Availability.Name: Availability
Availability.Hint: When players may choose the risky d20.
Availability.Unlock: Only when the GM unlocks it

OnlyD20Tests.Name: Only d20 tests
OnlyD20Tests.Hint: Only attacks, ability checks, skill checks and saving throws of the dnd5e system are affected. Off: every d20, including free rolls like /r 1d20.

Once.Name: Single roll only
Once.Hint: The toggle resets automatically after one risky roll. Off: stays active until you turn it off.

ShowButton.Name: Show panel
ShowButton.Hint: Shows the risky d20 panel above the player list. As GM you can also set the number of ones and twenties there.
